towerFx.architecture: uses existing RedBlack tower pixels; no independent tower asset
towerFx.tuning: neutral structure lift -> restrained late gold bias -> exposure-only pulse
towerFx.rationale: latest RedBlack master already defines tower color, so FX no longer repaints it orange
towerFx.isolation: tight tower-content mask only; no intentional sky/city/window animation

birdFx.architecture: procedural shader silhouettes; no external bird asset
birdFx.scope: Open state only; overlaps Tower FX

timeline: Tower FX and Bird FX run in parallel after Open; final Open Hold begins after the longer Open FX track finishes
